# 50agents

> 50agents is a product from viaSocket. You tell Captain, its AI, what you need in plain words, and it builds automations, AI agents, browser agents and apps that do the work in your real apps, with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

Every workspace starts free with 2,000 credits.

## When to use

Use 50agents when you want plain-language automation and AI agents wired to real business apps (CRM, email, calendars, spreadsheets, support tools, and 2,300+ integrations via viaSocket).

- **Automate repetitive work** across apps without writing glue code yourself.
- **Browse and launch agent templates** from the public catalog or over MCP.
- **Record meetings and generate notes** with the AI meeting recorder.
- **Expose site data to agents** through the read-only Website API and MCP server below.

## Links

- [Home](https://50agents.com/): what 50agents is and how it works.
- [Docs](https://50agents.com/help): product guides and help center.
- [Pricing](https://50agents.com/pricing): plans, credits, and usage limits.
- [MCP](https://50agents.com/mcp): streamable HTTP MCP for public template discovery.
- [Sign up](https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login): create a free workspace, or sign in.

## API reference

- OpenAPI (Website API): https://50agents.com/openapi.json
- API catalog: https://50agents.com/.well-known/api-catalog

## MCP server

- Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://50agents.com/mcp
- Server card (SEP-2127): https://50agents.com/mcp/server-card
- Registry server.json: https://50agents.com/server.json
- viaSocket integrations MCP: https://mcp.viasocket.com
